segments.he: רַבִּי יוֹסֵי אוֹמֵר: לֹא נֶחְלְקוּ כּוּ׳. תַּנְיָא, אָמַר לָהֶן רַבִּי יוֹסֵי: דִּקְדַּקְתֶּם אַחֲרַי.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches that «Rabbi Yosei says:» Rabbi Eliezer and Rabbi Yehoshua «did not disagree» with regard to one who performs prohibited labor during the intervening twilight period; rather, they both agree that he is exempt, as I say: He performed part of the labor today and he performed part of the labor the following day. It «is taught» in a baraita that «Rabbi Yosei said to» the other Sages: «You were diligent» to examine «my» opinion, and you found a refutation of my statement.
